Hi Samir — great to connect yesterday. Short answer: we support both models; each has tradeoffs.

Two pragmatic options we see work best for customers your size: 

Option A — Modular line items (recommended for internal chargebacks):
- Audit log retention: recurring fee by GB/month (tiered)
- KMS/HSM seat: either a monthly seat fee or a throughput-based uplift (we can show an example)
- Residency: a regional residency surcharge (flat per-region add-on)

Pros: clean accounting and easier to allocate across cost centers. Cons: more line items on the PO.

Option B — HIPAA Bundle (recommended if you want a single commercial object):
- Single recurring surcharge that covers audit retention (12-month baseline), KMS seat, and residency.
- Implementation credit: we typically offer an upfront credit that is amortized over 6–12 months against the recurring surcharge for 12-month commitments.

Example (ballpark for 5M tokens/month):
- Modular: Audit logs $800/month (tiered), KMS/HSM $2,500/month (1 seat), Residency us-west surcharge $1,200/month = ~ $4.5k/month recurring
- Bundle: Single surcharge $3,600/month + one-time implementation credit $12k that we amortize over 6 months (i.e., first 6 months effectively reduced)

I'm attaching a short pricing draft and the SOW evidence checklist so procurement can review. Feel free to share.

Next step: if procurement prefers one PO line, we can prepare a bundle SKU and a sample DocuSign addendum. If they prefer line items, we can send an itemized quote with unit rates and examples for commit tiers. Which would you like me to prepare?

Best,

Eve — thanks for the context and the draft. Quick guidance:

- Approve the bundle path for commercial simplicity. It shortens procurement cycles and reduces PO friction.
- Approve up to $15k implementation credit (we can mark $12k as standard, leave room to go to $15k if they push). Authorize amortization over 6 months.
- For larger commits (>=$2k/mo ARR uplift), layer in a 10% volume discount on the recurring surcharge after 6 months.

Set deal_id ATLS-2026-091, record in CRM, and route the DocuSign addendum with the bundle SKU. If procurement asks for line items for internal accounting, offer an internal split doc with equivalent unit rates but keep the PO as a single billing line (helps finance).
